title: Unconnected
summary: UNCONNECT'ED, adjective 1. Not connected; not united; separate. 2. Not coherent; not joined by proper transitions or dependence of parts; loose; vague; desultory; as an unconnected discourse.

inlines.v: UNCONNECT'ED, adjective 1. Not connected; not united; separate. 2. Not coherent; not joined by proper transitions or dependence of parts; loose; vague; desultory; as an unconnected discourse.
